ancientAltar.name: Ancient Altar
ancientAltar.onVisitedMessage:
{Ancient Altar}

Deep under the ground you find an ancient temple. An artifact of great power used to be kept here, but now the temple is empty.

rewards.message:
{Ancient Altar}

After defeating the monsters and searching the altar of the temple, you find the legendary Horn of the Abyss!
